name: m4-devirt-sym-prof2
description: Prototype evidence, step 2 of [retronym/scala#199](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/199): final `owner` / `thisSym` / `typeOfThis` / `tpe_*`, a TypeRef fast path for `Type.mapOver` in SubstMap / AsSeenFromMap / TypeMap.mapOver, and a ClassInfoType fast path for `decls` in walkBaseClasses, against step 1 (the final kind predicates and `info`/`rawInfo`). PMU profile (cycles, instructions) through the kperf helper, scala corpus, one fork per build, for attributing `vtable stub` / `itable stub` samples to their callers. Not a timing A/B. Base `00e3bbafb8` is in `m4-devirt-sym-prof`.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap, single-shot 4+4 ops, as `m4-int00e3bb-kperf-l1d`.
